_comment: Issue #166 M2: model digest verification. Maps each shipped base model tag to the manifest digest Kestrel tested and the date. Captured 2026-11-04 from the ollama-content-digest header of registry.ollama.ai (the manifest digest, which Ollama's /api/tags reports as 'digest'; the first 12 characters are the ID shown by 'ollama list'). The doctor compares the local model's digest against this catalog. A mismatch warns (tag has moved); a tag not listed here is reported as unknown. Never blocks. An empty list is reported as 'not recorded yet', never as a pass.
